title: IvyDB TradeFlow measurement validity and preregistered falsification protocol

source_evidence.vendor_advertised_scope: Every US option across all US options exchanges; not independently sample-verified

methodology_example.interpretation: Coverage/assignment rate in one vendor-selected session; not independently measured directional accuracy

measurement_semantics.buy_sell: Aggressor-side direction, not opening/closing position status
measurement_semantics.institutional_2: Aggressive liquidity-demand proxy only; excludes passive, midpoint, patient position-building and market-making activity

literature_interpretation.pan_poteshman_2006: Buyer-initiated opening-position option volume predicts underlying returns in a proprietary dataset; TradeFlow does not provide opening-position status and cannot reproduce that measure directly.
literature_interpretation.bryzgalova_pavlova_sikorskaya_2023: Retail option imbalance predicts next-day underlying returns in their sample but not weekly/monthly returns; authors interpret the short-lived pattern as more consistent with intermediary hedging/price pressure than informed retail trading.
literature_interpretation.option_order_flow_inventory_risk_2015: Inventory-risk effects can dominate asymmetric-information effects in option prices; directional imbalance must not automatically be labelled informed flow.
literature_interpretation.implication: Continuation, transient price pressure and reversal are competing hypotheses; none is assumed.

candidate_features_not_computed.guard: Keep unclassified contracts in total_contracts and report unclassified_share separately; do not renormalize only classified volume.
Only use Greeks and multipliers known by the interval's actual availability timestamp; otherwise use contract-level measures or a preregistered lagged Greek.

candidate_features_not_computed.definition: Institutional_2 buyer-initiated minus seller-initiated flow, delta-notional weighted where eligible.
candidate_features_not_computed.guard: Use Institutional_2 alone; never add Institutional_1 because it is nested.

candidate_features_not_computed.definition: Retail_1, Retail_2 and Retail_3 signed flows, first tested separately; optional aggregate only after raw-sample mutual-exclusivity validation.
candidate_features_not_computed.guard: Do not treat proxy labels as account identity or ground truth.

candidate_features_not_computed.definition: Unclassified share, NBBO-location shares, condition-code mix, multi-leg share and venue concentration.
candidate_features_not_computed.guard: Midpoint is nested inside inside-NBBO; use at_NBBO + inside_NBBO + outside_NBBO for total. Test multi-leg flow separately.

hypotheses_not_tested.claim: Signed flow predicts underlying returns beyond prior returns, volatility, liquidity and event controls.
hypotheses_not_tested.falsification: No incremental effect after controls, unstable signs across chronological OOS periods, or effect confined to same-session returns.

hypotheses_not_tested.claim: Flow predicts contemporaneous/very-short-horizon movement followed by reversal.
hypotheses_not_tested.falsification: No short-lived response or reversal after costs and liquidity controls.

hypotheses_not_tested.claim: Institutional_2 aggressive-flow proxy has different persistence from Retail_1/2/3 proxies.
hypotheses_not_tested.falsification: No stable difference, or results depend on overlapping/nested buckets or historical field backfill.

hypotheses_not_tested.claim: Flow adds information conditional on contemporaneous IV/skew/term structure.
hypotheses_not_tested.falsification: Interaction disappears when using only time-aligned Greeks or after controlling for IV repricing.

hypotheses_not_tested.claim: Condition, NBBO-location and venue composition explain variation in flow's predictive content.
hypotheses_not_tested.falsification: No incremental effect beyond total flow, liquidity and market-regime controls.

controls_required: realized volatility and contemporaneous/prior IV level, skew and term structure
option volume, open interest, bid-ask spread and underlying dollar ADV
DTE, delta/moneyness, call/put and contract multiplier
earnings, corporate actions and scheduled macro-event indicators
multi-leg share, trade-condition mix, venue concentration and unclassified share
market beta, size, sector and market regime
horizon_grid: remainder of session where receipt-time intraday replay is valid

pit_rules.first_usable_time: Maximum of TradeFlow first receipt, required Greek/underlying data first receipt, and effective-dated identity availability.
pit_rules.historical_backfill: 2016+ vendor backfill may support retrospective predictive research only after proving every input is event-time causal and methodology-stable; it does not prove a strategy could have received the proprietary feature live in 2016.
pit_rules.intraday: Use only snapshots actually received by the decision timestamp; do not assume nominal interval end equals delivery time.
pit_rules.interval_semantics: Do not difference, sum or treat snapshots as incremental until interval boundaries and cumulative-versus-incremental semantics are confirmed.
pit_rules.corrections: Preserve each vintage; never replace a historical decision-time value with a later corrected file.
pit_rules.greeks: Never use a later 15:45 Greek for an earlier interval; use contemporaneous received data or a preregistered prior snapshot.
pit_rules.identity: Use effective-dated option and underlying identifiers, including expired/delisted contracts and corporate actions.

admission_gates.gate: Raw sample across 2016, 2020, 2023 and 2026, including active and inactive/delisted underlyings
Complete data dictionary, exact interval boundaries and cumulative-versus-incremental semantics
First-publication/first-receipt timestamps and actual delivery latency
Immutable corrections, cancellations, late-trade and revision-vintage policy
Classifier methodology versions and historical backfill consistency
Independent direction-label validation by trade condition, midpoint, venue and market regime
Effective-dated security/contract identity and delisted coverage
Pricing, internal-use license and derived-data rights

validation_protocol.baseline: F80_TOP20_PARTIAL50_BASELINE_C20 remains frozen; compare incremental signal with identical exposure and costs.
validation_protocol.chronology: Use repository-approved chronological development/validation splits; do not random-split time series.
validation_protocol.robustness: Date-block bootstrap, ticker/sector/year leave-one-out, regime stability and multiple-testing control.
validation_protocol.economics: Include executable equity or option costs, spread/slippage, turnover, capacity and borrow where applicable.
validation_protocol.return_chasing: Separate same-session price impact from next-session and longer-horizon continuation/reversal; residualize or control for prior returns and IV repricing.
validation_protocol.holdout: Locked final holdout remains untouched until all definitions and model choices are frozen.
validation_protocol.holding_period: Evaluate the horizon grid; no minimum or maximum holding period is imposed.
